svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
svg.title: Placemento architecture
svg.desc: Placemento architecture. 8 components in 1 groups. Connections: Students, coordinators, admins to React 19 SPA; React 19 SPA to Helmet, CORS, rate limit (Bearer JWT); Helmet, CORS, rate limit to Auth routes; Helmet, CORS, rate limit to JWT and role checks; JWT and role checks to Resource routes; Express 5 API (server/) to MongoDB (Mongoose); Auth routes to Gmail SMTP (OTP email).

text.tspan: A React SPA calls an Express 5 REST API backed by MongoDB; Gmail sends the password reset OTPs
